The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant-Yashwant Yadav with the prayer to quash the impugned summoning order dated 19.11.2022 as well as entire criminal proceeding of Criminal Complaint Case No.21043 of 2022, u/s 420 IPC, P.S. sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.

It is argued that the applicant is posted as Village Panchayat Officer, Jaispur Block - Saidpur, District Ghazipur and is having charge of village Maksoodpur, Village Kotisa, Chiraunakala and Darhepur, District Ghazipur.
It is argued that the opposite party no.2 moved an application dated 14.01.2022 under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. with totally false and frivolous allegations.

The said application was treated as complaint on which the statement of the complainant and his witnesses were recorded under Section 200 and 202 Cr.P.C. after which the trial court summoned the applicant and other co-accused persons vide order dated 19.11.2022.
It is argued that the applicant entered the name in the family register as per the provisions of Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Raj (Maintenance of Family Registers) Rules, 1970.

entities.text: Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Raj (Maintenance of Family Registers) Rules, 1970
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The remedy to a person aggrieved was to file an appeal before the Sub Divisional Officer within thirty days against the said entry but without adopting the proper legal remedy, application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. has been filed.
It is argued that the applicant is not the beneficiary in any manner by the said entry.
No offence whatsoever is made out against the applicant.
Matter requires consideration.
Notice on behalf of opposite party no. 1 has been accepted by learned counsel for the State.
Issue notice to the opposite party no. 2 returnable within six weeks.
Opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. may file counter affidavits within six weeks.
Rejoinder affidavit, if any, may thereafter be filed within three weeks.
Let the matter be listed on 26.07.2023.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against applicant in the aforesaid case.
(Samit Gopal, J.)
